FreezeAndPortals.title: Freeze-and-Branch & Scroll Portals
FreezeAndPortals.subtitle: Pin source context, spawn multi-pane trails, and link figures dynamically

scenes.caption: Reading dense papers means jumping constantly. Pinleaf lets you freeze your active pane with F, or split right with Command D.
Branch deeper with Split Down, new windows, or Detach Pane. Clicking Theorem 2 in a frozen pane smart-routes the active descendant.
Scroll-Linked Portals bind any reading paragraph to a figure or equation with P. Toggle a Portal Follower pane with Shift P.
As you scroll down the paper, your follower pane updates automatically from Figure 1 to Equation 4 and persists per document.

NavigationSmartJumpHints.title: Smart Jump, Hints & Navigation
NavigationSmartJumpHints.subtitle: Command Palette, unlinked ref resolution, Vimium hints, TOC & regex search

scenes.caption: Press Slash or Question Mark anytime to open the Command Palette. Type keywords to filter actions and inspect platform shortcuts instantly.
Heuristic Smart Jump resolves unlinked labels like Figure 1, Theorem 1, or Citation 12. Right-click opens a floating Overview card.
Stay completely keyboard-driven with Vimium two-letter hints. Semicolon jumps links, Colon opens Overview previews, and V selects text between two words.
Explore with Auto-TOC on T, regex search via Command F, single-key marks with m and backtick, jump history, and Vim scrolling.

AnnotationsCategoriesLibrary.title: PDF Annotations, 26 Categories & Library
AnnotationsCategoriesLibrary.subtitle: Standard ISO-32000 /Annots persistence, typed highlight buckets & cross-PDF search

scenes.caption: Select text cleanly across two columns to highlight, attach inline notes, underline, or frame figures. Command S saves standard PDF annotations atomically.
Organize thoughts into twenty-six typed highlight buckets using H plus a through z, persisted inside the PDF and customizable in config JSON.
Toggle the Notes Sidebar with Shift Command A. Filter your highlights live by category badge to isolate Theorems, Methods, or Open Questions.
Switch papers instantly with Quick-Open Recent, search quotes across your entire library with Shift Command F, or look up DOIs on Google Scholar.

ThemesComfortPresentation.title: Smart Dark Mode, Comfort & Presentation
ThemesComfortPresentation.subtitle: Figure-preserving dark & custom themes, content fit, ruler, auto-scroll & F5 slides

scenes.caption: Cycle through Light, Dark, Warm Sepia, and Custom palette modes with F8. Custom background and foreground hex colors live in your config file.
Shift F8 toggles Smart Dark Figure Preservation. Pinleaf detects raster plots and diagrams so charts keep crisp natural colors inside dark mode.
Crop whitespace with W for Content Width, track dense lines using the Visual Reading Ruler on R, and toggle smooth auto-scroll with F6.
Need to present slides? Press F5 for chrome-free fullscreen Presentation Mode that fits whole pages cleanly, and hit Escape to return.

SynctexIpcExtensions.title: SyncTeX, CLI IPC & Extensions
SynctexIpcExtensions.subtitle: Live LaTeX/Typst auto-reload, two-way SyncTeX, Unix socket IPC & shell extensions

scenes.caption: Pinleaf watches your compiled PDF on disk and reloads edits automatically while keeping every scroll anchor, zoom level, and split pane intact.
Built-in pure Rust SyncTeX powers instant two-way jumping. Forward search highlights compiled lines in cyan, and Command Click jumps back to your editor.
Script live windows over a private Unix domain socket. Run execute-command from any terminal to jump pages, split panes, or run searches.
Press Shift Command E or custom hotkeys to run shell or Python extensions, safely passing selected quotes, DOIs, and paths to external workflows.
